mapping.summary: Recurring subscription invoicing built on standard blanket sales orders, with access-key API.
claims: Each subscription contract is a blanket sales order with service type set to subscription
Contracts can bill items, resources or G/L accounts with their own frequency, renewal period and start date
Lines can be billed in advance or in arrears
A single run backfills all unbilled periods since the last billed date
One-off charges such as setup fees can sit alongside recurring lines
Combines all due subscriptions per bill-to customer and currency on one invoice
Spreads revenue over the service period using deferral templates
Applies CPI-style percentage price indexation to a filtered batch of lines
Upgrades or downgrades take effect from a future period without touching invoiced periods
Batch invoicing can run from the job queue and never bills a period twice
Invoice lines state the service period they cover
Exposes subscription access status through a read-only OAuth 2.0 API
Overdue subscriptions can be suspended automatically at a chosen reminder level
Access keys can be regenerated, invalidating the old key immediately
Tracks MRR, ARR and renewals in a dedicated role center
